playerMetadata.pitch: Raw gold and brand-new weapons are appearing in the hands of the Black Fang goblins. Trace the wealth to an abandoned dwarven mine where stealth, old machinery and one bad alarm can change the whole dungeon.
playerMetadata.setting: An abandoned dwarven mine in the Highlands

hard.rule: A minor earthquake exposed a limited gold vein that Xikek used to rearm the Black Fangs; it is already nearly exhausted.
Entrance-guard warning changes pit state and mine/leadership deployment globally.
Area 5's five goblins do not reinforce Area 4.
The damaged dwarven automaton understands only simple Dwarven commands and has a 20% catastrophic-failure chance while moving.
Deeper elevator-accessed levels are source-authorised GM expansion, not written source canon.

conditional.rule: If entrance guards successfully warn the mine, one arms Area 2's pit.
If Area 4 combat exceeds six rounds while leadership remains in Area 6, Xikek/Snerk/Yuliak investigate.

soft.rule: Several hooks can lead to the mine: gold/new weapons, missing prospectors, trader connection or similar local investigation.

freeImprovisation.rule: Generated deeper mine content is allowed only after crossing the explicit source boundary and must be labelled DMOS continuation/homebrew.

locations.name: Mine Exterior
locations.description: South-side mountain portal with goblin signs and dirty runoff.

locations.name: Area 1 - Guards
locations.description: Two entrance guards; their escape can alert the mine.

locations.name: Area 2 - Pit of Protection
locations.description: 35-foot old dwarven pit with disable lever and narrow ledge.

locations.name: Area 3 - Elevator to the Underdark
locations.description: Damaged elevator shaft and Tentacle Worm; written-source expansion boundary.
secrets: Deeper levels are not written canon.

locations.name: Area 4 - The Mine
locations.description: Main mining chamber, workforce and damaged dwarven automaton.
secrets: Secret work area with incomplete automaton/toolbox.

locations.name: Area 5 - Tribal Lair
locations.description: Five off-duty goblins who do not help the mine battle.

locations.name: Area 6 - Chief's Chamber
locations.description: Xikek/Snerk/Yuliak default location and trapped treasure chest.

npcs.name: Xikek the Loud
secrets: Does not know mine history or that the vein is nearly exhausted.

npcs.name: Dwarven Mining Automaton
secrets: Simple Dwarven command parser; catastrophic-failure risk.

clocks.name: Area 4 Battle Noise
clocks.advanceRule: Advance one per combat round while leadership remains in Area 6; after round 6 they investigate.
effects: Leadership remains Area 6 through six rounds
After six rounds leadership moves toward Area 4

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Set mine alert only when actions actually warn guards.

scenes.title: Guards and Dwarven Pit
requiredFacts: Guard escape can arm pit and alert mine; pit has lever and ledge.

scenes.title: Mine Junction
requiredFacts: West is elevator; east is active mine.

scenes.title: The Active Mine
requiredFacts: Main force, alert-dependent leadership and damaged automaton are here/affected by state.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Track combat rounds and leadership movement; Area 5 never reinforces.

scenes.title: Lair and Leadership
requiredFacts: Area 5 and Area 6 occupancy reflect prior alert/noise movement.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: No room resets; use actual actor locations/deaths/surrender state.

endings.title: Black Fang Mine Resolved
endings.summary: Party leaves/reports with outcome based on tribe, leadership, treasure and salvage actually achieved.

endings.title: Deeper Mine Continuation
endings.summary: Written source ends; a labelled DMOS/homebrew continuation begins below the elevator shaft.

adaptationNotes: Actual-play reports show level-1 use can be dangerous.
Do not import community Steel Fisted Goblins into canon.
